description: Create a dashboard; with a ref already in use, return that dashboard with created false. With shareWith, an account an agent opened shares only after the person has claimed it. One call can make a live page: send visuals and publish true, and the answer carries the dashboard's url. A ref already used by one of the owner's dashboards returns that dashboard, unchanged, with created false; its visuals are then created or found by their own refs, so a run cut short is finished by the next one. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

dryRun.description: Check everything and write nothing; answers 200 { dryRun: true } or the error the real call would give.

publish.description: Make the page public for anyone with the link, as POST /v1/dashboards/{id}/publish would.

ref.description: A slug you choose, 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -. Unique per owner for dashboards and per dashboard for visuals, and set once. Create with a ref so a later run finds the same object instead of making a duplicate.

shareWith.description: People who may view the dashboard after signing in with these addresses, each made as POST /v1/dashboards/{id}/shares would and emailed the link: view-only, and the dashboard stays private unless publish is true too. An account an agent opened shares only after the person has claimed it: until then the whole call answers 403 claim_required.

visuals.description: Created in order, each as POST /v1/dashboards/{id}/visuals would, so give every visual a ref when the dashboard has one.

size.description: Defaults to the type's default size. Width and height within the type's limits, which describe_visual_types lists per type with the widths the editor offers.
